_comment: T-609 (HUD and menus, Content, 'Controller texts'; Decisions, 'Controller support in the menus and prompts'): the texts shown instead of keyboard ones when the player last used a controller (T-610 reads this file). 'glyphs' are the short labels drawn on the button glyphs (Xbox names for every controller, a proposal for the playtest). 'key_to_glyph' maps the keyboard keys of keycap recipes and live key pads (trick_recipes.json keys, tutorial_practice.json pads) to a glyph. 'lines' has one controller version per keyboard line, keyed '<file> <key path>' like the source; '_comment_<n>' lines say where each shows. A controller line is never longer than the keyboard line it replaces. Style loop: every line scored 8 or more (T-609's Style review).

glyphs._comment: Short labels drawn on the glyphs, in the keycaps' style: left stick, D-pad, left and right triggers, A, B, Y, left and right bumpers, Start, plus X (the tutorial's Replay) and View (the Back button, the tutorial's Skip demo), T-617.

key_to_glyph._comment: Keys of recipes and live pads -> glyph name. W is gas (right trigger), S brake and reverse (left trigger), A and D are the one steering glyph (so the recipes' '/D' either-tag is not drawn), Space the jump (A), R the practice reset (Y), Enter selects (A), Escape goes back (B), Tab/arrows have no controller line.
